rows: A Grace Period follow-up was filtered on the wrong field and the expiry stretched from 1 day to 3. Players who had already claimed got a second notice
Wrong filter field; no second check before sending
A filter mistake is a money mistake. Any list that triggers a bonus needs a second pair of eyes. Never extend an expiry without approval
Two players across 13 Zyra brands with near-identical deposit and betting patterns withdrew RM 126,640. On one brand: deposited RM 10, placed RM 20 bets, kept betting past the visible balance
Suspected provider wallet or settlement fault, worked by coordinated accounts. Caught only by manual cross-brand checks
Small deposit into large withdrawal is the signal. The same pattern on a second brand confirms it. Betting past the visible balance is a system alarm, not luck. Escalate to the provider at once
Cross-brand monitoring; escalate to provider and technical team
Wallets with unusually high referral free credit built up fast, with unnatural registration patterns and similar behaviour across linked accounts. Found at withdrawal review
Referral terms loosely enforced; withdrawal screening did not flag promo-heavy wallets
A wallet made mostly of referral credit at withdrawal is a red flag, not a win. Judge conversion quality, not referral count. Check linked banking and device similarity
